summary: DAY revision preserves the independent same-cycle expectations/execution pass and applies the locked readiness rule: absence of a canonical live price/consensus/crowding feed is not a T0 baseline-promotion blocker. Operating reality, event risk and expectation-saturation are documented for all 12 names; exact valuation precision remains intentionally unknown. All 12 are advisory ready_for_chief from this lane, while underwriting/source lanes may independently keep company dossiers incomplete for required baseline evidence.

perCompanyCoverage.expectationTest: Neutron/M&A path dependence keeps execution asymmetry high; current valuation remains unknown by design, not a baseline blocker.
unknowns: Live valuation/consensus, Neutron timing, acquisition financing.

perCompanyCoverage.expectationTest: Hypergrowth plus concentrated demand creates a high expectations bar; exact market-implied expectations are non-canonical and remain unknown.
Design-win growth can support premium expectations while customer/warrant concentration raises asymmetry; no execution-lane required input is missing for baseline review.
Extraordinary operating reality creates an exceptionally high forward bar; execution discipline requires separating quality from whatever premium the market currently embeds.
Rapid data-center growth is real; forward asymmetry depends on durable repeat deployment/share rather than one strong catch-up phase.
unknowns: Live valuation/consensus and normalized accelerator margin expectations.

perCompanyCoverage.expectationTest: AI semiconductor growth is so strong that deceleration itself can become a negative expectation event even without business deterioration.
unknowns: Live valuation/consensus/crowding and customer-specific program expectations.

perCompanyCoverage.expectationTest: Current operating strength is exceptional; execution opportunity depends on how price balances growth versus geopolitical/overseas-fab risk, which remains intentionally unquantified without canonical market data.
unknowns: Live valuation and market-implied geopolitical discount.

perCompanyCoverage.expectationTest: Scarcity economics support premium expectations while export policy/order timing can create lumpy resets; no canonical market feed is required for baseline promotion.
Royalty growth plus production-silicon expansion raises both opportunity and execution complexity; exact market premium remains unknown rather than fabricated.
unknowns: Live valuation/consensus and AGI CPU margin expectations.

perCompanyCoverage.expectationTest: September 30 is the clearest near-term re-underwriting event; current peak profitability should not be treated as a terminal state.
unknowns: Live normalized valuation and post-peak consensus margins.

perCompanyCoverage.expectationTest: Elite growth/margins create a high-bar regime where customer/architecture concentration matters to forward asymmetry even when operating execution is excellent.
UIG expands time-to-power optionality while adding integration/capital-allocation event risk; exact valuation response remains non-canonical and unknown.
unknowns: Live valuation, UIG normalized economics, contingent-payout expectations.

materialFindings.finding: All 12 active-batch companies are advisory ready_for_chief from the expectations/execution lane because market/consensus/crowding precision is non-canonical for T0 and its absence does not prevent baseline review.
NVDA, AVGO, TSM, AMD, ANET and ARM remain in a high-expectations regime where operating strength itself raises the future execution bar; this must remain separate from Earth Score quality.
MU September 30 and VRT/RKLB transaction/engineering milestones remain high-information event risks; they are calendar/execution considerations rather than baseline company-readiness blockers.
Underwriting still has required baseline evidence gaps for each company; those independent gaps remain valid and are not overridden by execution-lane readiness.

contradictions: Excellent company quality can coexist with poor market asymmetry if expectations are saturated.
Unknown live valuation is not equivalent to unknown company baseline quality when valuation is not a canonical T0 input.
unknowns: Canonical timestamped live price, consensus and crowding data remain unavailable for this cycle.
Exact bear/base/bull per-share values should remain unproduced until reproducible market inputs exist.

peerRequests.request: Continue closing required company baseline inputs; do not treat missing live market/consensus data as a reason to hold baseline promotion.
Treat ready_for_chief=true here as execution-lane clearance only; preserve independent source/underwriting blockers and keep Earth Score separate from opportunity timing.

accuracyDebates.reason: Prevents optional/non-canonical price and consensus feeds from stalling T0 company baseline promotion while preserving execution uncertainty honestly.
